messages:
jen: quick heads up 1 — found a broken slimlink redirect in the runtime KB, hitting a 301->404 chain.
jen: curl output: ```
$ curl -IL https://short.redwood.ai/kvcache
HTTP/1.1 301 Moved Permanently
Location: https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache#old-prefetch
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
```
omar: ouch. do we own that shortlink mapping? could be a stale redirect from the old TOC. any idea how many pages point at it?
jen: ran a quick ripgrep across docs, found 4 refs: runtime, onboarding, integrations, ja-onboarding.
jen: ```
rg "short.redwood.ai/kvcache|#old-prefetch" docs/ -n
docs/runtime/kv-cache.md:45: [prefetch](https://short.redwood.ai/kvcache)
docs/onboarding/getting-started.md:12: /runtime/kv-cache#old-prefetch
...
```
liam: I can own a tiny patch to swap to the canonical anchor `#kv-prefetch` and update the shortlink to the new mapping. assigning to me if that's ok.
omar: thumbs up. also flagging localization: ja-onboarding links to the shortlink — can we confirm whether localized site uses the same slug? if not, we'll need a backport to ja tree.
liam: good call. i'll check ja tree after i open PR. if it's the same pattern i can include the ja change in the same branch.
docs-bot: nightly-link-scan: detected redirect-chain (rule: shortlink-redirect-loop). Ticket created: https://internal.redwood/links/TKT-20260321-88
omar: plan: liam creates PR with sed replacement + one-line changelog, mention ja localization in PR body; assign @jen or @omar for quick review. merge window: today (non-blocking).
liam: PR in 20m, will include grep output and list of affected files. pinging reviewers @jen @omar.
jen: thanks — adding note to the docs handoff doc so oncall sees it. mark as impact=low but triage=required.
liam: uploaded PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4987 — tiny, 4 files changed. left a TODO to follow up on the shortlink mapping in redirects service.
omar: review complete, left tiny nit about the ja message translation. once that's in, merge+cherry-pick to staging.
jen: closing loop. will follow up with redirects team about retiring the old shortlink mapping.
